concept.name: Forward test
concept.definition: Prospective evaluation of a frozen strategy on market data that arrives after development, without risking capital necessarily.
concept.intuition: It estimates how a fitted choice behaves on observations that were not used to fit that choice.
concept.mechanics: Version the rules, parameters, and code; record signals and simulated fills as new data arrive; compare results with prespecified expectations.
concept.failure_modes: Random splitting, overlapping labels, repeated tuning, or an unprotected final test set can produce optimistic estimates.
concept.misconceptions: Validation measures conditional generalization under a split design; it does not guarantee future market performance.
concept.example: A strategy frozen on June 30 produces timestamped shadow orders from July through December before any launch decision.

citations.source: SEC, Investment Adviser Advertisements; Compensation for Solicitations
